raw_text: A fabricated Ministry of Defence circular that went viral on social media has been officially debunked by PIB Fact Check and the Defence Ministry. The doctored document, which claimed to order emergency troop mobilization along the India-China border, used an outdated letterhead and contained formatting errors. Error Level Analysis confirmed digital manipulation around the signature and stamp areas of the document photograph.
clean_text: Fabricated MoD circular claiming emergency troop mobilization debunked by PIB Fact Check. Document used outdated letterhead, formatting errors, and showed digital manipulation in forensic analysis.
